## Checklist

- [ ] `python scripts/validate_resources.py` passes
- [ ] For a new or edited resource: description accurate and within 2,000 characters; licence and version date verified
- [ ] For a vocabulary change: `python scripts/build_issue_form.py` was run and the regenerated forms are committed
- [ ] For a resource being published: `status: published`
